tools.name: sebbi_overview
tools.description: Start here. Lists every sebbi.pro product with what it does, who it is for, its page and its price. Read-only, no account needed.

tools.name: sebbi_setup_advice
tools.description: Recommends the right sebbi.pro products for how someone builds (Python, Node, Lovable, Zapier, a website, a phone app...) and gives step-by-step setup with working code or a ready-made prompt. Pass their stack and what they want to achieve. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_terms
tools.description: Returns the service terms and their version. Show the full text to the person and get a clear yes before calling sebbi_create_account. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_create_account
tools.description: Opens a sebbi.pro account and returns the API key. Only call after showing sebbi_terms and the person agreeing; pass the terms_version they agreed to and customer_agreed=true. The agreement is sealed into the chain. Free for 7 days.

tools.name: sebbi_test_decision
tools.description: Sends one decision through the live engine with their API key and returns the verdict (ALLOW, CHALLENGE or BLOCK), the reasons and the sealed block number, so they see it working end to end. Writes one record to the chain.

tools.name: sebbi_billing_link
tools.description: Returns a secure Stripe link where the person adds a card for the 50p per device per month subscription. Nothing is charged until they complete it.

tools.name: sebbi_verify_chain
tools.description: Re-checks every block in the sebbi.pro chain and returns its height, tip and whether it is intact. Anyone can run it; no account needed. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_notarize
tools.description: Timestamps one or more SHA-256 fingerprints in Bitcoin through the free notary. Hash the file or text yourself and send only the 64-character fingerprint; the content never leaves. Returns a receipt code and link for each.

tools.name: sebbi_find_checks
tools.description: Searches sebbi.pro's 755 compliance checks across 32 frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA, ISO/IEC 42001 and 27001, NIST AI RMF, UK Online Safety Act, EU DSA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CCPA, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, ICO Children's Code, US state AI laws, model risk, and agent-output gates). Filter by f

tools.name: sebbi_run_everything
tools.description: Runs all 755 compliance checks (or the frameworks named) on one governance record in a single call. Returns the overall score, a score for every framework, and the fixes that unlock the most checks first. By default seals the scorecard into Bitcoin with its own page and code (SC-XXXX-XXXX) to send t

tools.name: sebbi_banking_pay_check
tools.description: Call before releasing ANY payment, whether an AI agent or a payment system is sending it. One call checks the agent's authority (Mandate Chain, Agent Passport or Spend Gate token), the payee's sealed bank details (Payment Notary), the human kill switch (Jugular) and every FCA-named fraud indicator,

tools.name: sebbi_spend_request
tools.description: Call before every payment an AI agent makes. Returns a signed APPROVED or DENIED token checked against the agent's limits. Release the money only if it is APPROVED and spendable. sebbi.pro never holds or moves money.

tools.name: sebbi_jugular_check
tools.description: Call before taking any action for a system that has a Jugular (a human-held kill switch, id JG-XXXX-XXXX). Returns live true or false. If live is false, or the check fails, do not act: the human holding the switch has stopped this system (EU AI Act Article 14(4)(e) stop button). Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_court_pack
tools.description: Produces a printable Court Pack for a sebbi fact (any record code, chain block number or notarised SHA-256): the fact, the sealed record, the step-by-step proof to Bitcoin, a method statement, and draft declarations for England and Wales (witness statement), US Federal Rules of Evidence 902(13)/902(

tools.description: Automated Enforcement Loop: when the customer's sealed decisions cross a threshold, sebbi.pro acts at once. tools.description: Forensic Replay Sandbox. Replays every AI decision sealed with the customer's API key under a new rule set and returns which verdicts would change, which way, by month, the money behind them and the rule that caused each. Rule set: allow_below and block_from (verdict boundaries, today 0.35 and 0.70)

tools.description: The customer's live Insurability Level (I-0 to I-4) worked out from their sealed AI behaviour over the last 30 days: records verify and no receipts missing (I-1), humans review flags with real reading time (I-2), an armed enforcement loop and kill switch (I-3), agent payments need approval (I-4). tools.description: For a person who was turned down by a computer (credit, a job, insurance, an account, benefits, housing). Writes their legal request under UK GDPR Articles 22A-22D and 15 or EU GDPR Articles 22 and 15 (and AI Act Article 86 where it applies), seals it with a timestamp so the one-month deadline is pr

tools.name: sebbi_tools
tools.description: sebbi.pro has more tools than are listed up front: banking and fraud cases, human oversight, law lookups and Law Lock, insurability, Signal Packs, answer receipts, the Examiner, readiness reports, incidents, energy, Bot School and more. This returns each one's name, what it does and its inputs. Pass

tools.description: Calls any sebbi.pro tool by its name with its arguments, including the ones not listed up front (see sebbi_tools). Use it when an answer's next_tools names a tool you do not see in your list. Same result as calling the tool directly.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sebbi_terms" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the service terms and their version. Show the full text to the person and get a clear yes before calling sebbi_create_account. Read-only.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sebbi_banking_pay_check" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sebbi_insurer_level · Private data: sebbi_create_account, sebbi_test_decision, sebbi_notarize, sebbi_run_everything, sebbi_banking_pay_check, sebbi_spend_request, sebbi_court_pack, sebbi_forensic_replay, sebbi_insurer_level, sebbi_ask_why · Public sink: sebbi_notarize, sebbi_run_everything, sebbi_banking_pay_check, sebbi_enforce_create, sebbi_forensic_replay, sebbi_insurer_level, sebbi_ask_why · Destructive: sebbi_verify_chain, sebbi_find_checks, sebbi_run_everything, sebbi_banking_pay_check, sebbi_jugular_check, sebbi_enforce_create, sebbi_forensic_replay, sebbi_insurer_level.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sebbi_insurer_level · Private data: sebbi_create_account, sebbi_test_decision, sebbi_notarize, sebbi_run_everything, sebbi_banking_pay_check, sebbi_spend_request, sebbi_court_pack, sebbi_forensic_replay, sebbi_insurer_level, sebbi_ask_why · Public sink: sebbi_notarize, sebbi_run_everything, sebbi_banking_pay_check, sebbi_enforce_create, sebbi_forensic_replay, sebbi_insurer_level, sebbi_ask_why · Destructive: sebbi_verify_chain, sebbi_find_checks, sebbi_run_everything, sebbi_banking_pay_check, sebbi_jugular_check, sebbi_enforce_create, sebbi_forensic_replay, sebbi_insurer_level

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
